scenarioCoverage.scenario: Retry reuses the same immutable publication snapshot and exact message payloads.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Compare all fake transport payloads across the failed first attempt and incremented retry attempt byte-for-byte.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Retry rejects a receipt for a different snapshot and no network is used.
